payload.title: feat/shared-store-layer at 65a1cc5: union-merged events, id-ordered replay, discovery within the repository
payload.body: Commit 65a1cc5 on branch feat/shared-store-layer, from a7dbc00. hyp init writes .tree/.gitattributes (events/*.jsonl merge=union) and is refused with exit 1 where store discovery finds a store; discovery stops at the first directory holding .git; replay and the store cut order events by id, then actor; an appended id sorts after every id the store holds; a sandbox store cut replaces a base's own .tree. Specs, ADR 0022 and the placement texts change with it. Code and tests were written, and go test run, while building, before E's rubric; the rubric's checks run after it.

why: The first candidate commit for Q-75N8YM; the base a7dbc00 is its rival.
The candidate is commit 65a1cc5.

readings: G-1391DM#5: "every event id the store holds" has two meanings. Meaning 1: the ids of lines whose id has the event-id form, 26 upper-case ULID characters; replay rejects any other line. Meaning 2: the id in every events line, rejected lines included. Example: a.jsonl holds a rejected line with id 01mzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz. Under meaning 1 a new id 01M79... is correct; under meaning 2 it must sort after 01mzz.... This run used meaning 1. S1 tests meaning 2; H-8QBZ4Q fails it. Question: must an appended id also sort after the id of a line that replay rejects?

why: Pre-registered rubric (a) to (e) holds on 9643341 under meaning 1 of line 5; S1 tests meaning 2; the review's test gap is a limit.
